integrity: The all-modulus proof is analytic. The finite verifier is corroborative and is not used to infer the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Specific to consecutive support \(\{0,1,2,3\}\) and equal coefficient magnitudes; does not classify arbitrary four-point supports or unequal magnitudes. A residual originality risk remains for differently indexed older sequence-design or cyclotomic literature.
title: Parity classification of Fourier zeros for phase-only consecutive quadrinomials
